mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the wings to the follower was most worthwhile because the explanation showed how one rising rod moves both hinged wings while the body stays still.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the tail was the least informative passage: it advanced the construction but gave little explanation beyond the result.

surprise.text: Changing the cam required raising and securing the follower and withdrawing the shaft; the detailed exchange made the mechanism feel more tangible.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; each followed a concrete construction or testing goal.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see what Jo's old drawing and its empty outline mean for the fair, and how the finished toys fit into it.
